page.overview:
Who is Albert Hinkey?

Albert Hinkey is one of the minor characters in Cars and Cars 3. He is a massive motor home and is one of Lightning McQueen's biggest fans.

"Albert Hinkey is McQueen's biggest fan -- known as the "Buffet Master" among friends, Al can guzzle two gas stations worth of fuel in one sitting! To match his size, Al is the biggest and best friend one can ever have."

In the film, Albert is sitting in the middle of the Motor Speedway of the South, among other caravans. He shouts encouraging words to McQueen after he makes it through the big wreck caused by Chick Hicks, and honks his horn loudly, much to the annoyance of the other caravans and a tiny blue car next to him.

Later, he appears next to Larry Camper and Doug R.M. attending the race at the Los Angeles International Speedway as they cheer on Lightning McQueen. He gets amazed when he and the rest of the crowd notice Doc Hudson. He's also shown crying in joy when he witnesses McQueen forfeit his victory so he can help Strip Weathers finish his last race, much to the delight of R.M. Following McQueen helping the King, Albert also praises the King once more for having completed his final race through the help of McQueen.
